category_title: Students who shout out answers and wave hands to participate
minimal_context: The teacher is asking a question to the class during a whole-class instructional session.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Class, we are going to review the reading assignment. Who can tell me the main character's name?

STUDENT: (Looks very excited to participate in class and starts raising his hand.)

TUTOR: Take a moment to think about it.

STUDENT: (Waves his hand in the air eagerly.)

TUTOR: I'm looking for someone to answer.

STUDENT: It's Thomas! Thomas is the main character! (Shouts out the answer as he waves his hands in the air.)

options.A: Whisper to the student during the whole-class session, asking, 'How well can you understand the reading assignment?'
options.B: Describe the inappropriate behavior. Using objective, behavioral terms, describe the antecedent events that led up to the displayed misbehavior.
options.C: Call attention to the reading assignment by asking the class to put their hands up, slap their desks twice, and say 'Reading!'
options.D: Put off the reading review activity you planned to do; wait until the student lowers his hands.
